caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected at full canvas size; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A large aspirational headline leads into a three-part framework; the performance phrase sits in a prominent lavender rough-lettered capsule.
visual_anatomy.layout: A full-page three-column matrix uses shared rows for description, mechanism, mistakes, focus, mental journey, process, and daily routine, allowing each column to contain a different kind of internal diagram.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title and framework statement → the three column headers → shared rows from top to bottom, with the lower process row functioning as the detailed operational reference.
visual_anatomy.typography: Oversized sans title with rough accent tag, strong black table labels, compact sans body copy, and sparse handwritten-style language inside the mental-journey row.
visual_anatomy.colour: Lavender, aqua, and blue identify the three columns from header to process cells; pale fills distinguish submodules without replacing the table structure.
visual_anatomy.surface: White field, strong black table rules, softly rounded miniature diagrams, restrained shadow, and low-contrast colour fills inside the matrix.
visual_anatomy.modules: Three framework columns crossed with seven shared rows; the mechanism row uses different micro-diagrams while the process row repeats numbered actions.
visual_anatomy.density: Very high: the stable row-and-column system makes several kinds of advice comparable without treating them as one undifferentiated list.

motion.observed_state_change: The shared matrix remains fixed while the mental-journey row temporarily gains a coloured segmented strip and a short internal statement; the near-complete sample shows that emphasis receding/resetting rather than a changed matrix structure.
motion.motion_job: Add a small state cue to the one row that describes an internal transition while preserving the complete comparison board.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Compare several complementary capabilities across the same practical questions and see where a state transition belongs.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Multi-criterion capability matrix with row-specific micro-encodings.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Keep the comparison grid stable, but let a row whose content is genuinely temporal use a compact state cue instead of forcing every row into prose.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when the columns share the same criteria and the animated row represents a real state progression that remains legible in the static frame.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the source’s communication taxonomy, title claim, institutional references, row labels, three-column matrix, coloured mental-journey strip, card treatments, or animation loop.

claim_boundary.note: The asset includes a quantified training claim and named organisations. The corpus does not independently verify those claims or the asserted caption association.
